The '''''Starshot''''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It participated in an [[Attack on SkyWind III|attack]] on the diplomatic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[SkyWind III]]''.
